# SurgeGrid AI — Real-Time Electrical Grid & Flood Resiliency Console

> Operational intelligence, real-time meteorological tracking via Google DeepMind WeatherNext 3, satellite flood inundation models, and automated line tripping defense protocols for Chennai's 75+ TNEB electrical substations.

SurgeGrid AI is an open-source, civic crisis-resilience platform for monitoring and mitigating electrical infrastructure hazards during severe weather, cyclones, and urban flooding across Greater Chennai.

## Web Console & Applications
- [SurgeGrid AI Web Console](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/): Interactive geospatial dashboard visualizing Chennai's 286 electrical substations, 2,893 11kV feeder lines, and 17,000+ distribution transformers (DTR).
- [Full Technical Specification](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical architecture, physical grid topology, and operational protocols for LLMs and autonomous agents.

## Core Data & Topology
- [TNEB Chennai Electrical Grid Dataset](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/data/chennai_tneb_grid.json): Complete topological model of Chennai's 400kV, 230kV, 110kV, and 33kV substations with incoming/outgoing feeder linkages and geo-coordinates.
- [AI Catalog Manifest](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) catalog defining AI tools and MCP endpoints.
- [Sitemap](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/sitemap.xml): Search engine and crawler index of console endpoints.

## Agentic & MCP Integration
- [ARD Specification Manifest](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/.well-known/ard.json): ARD standard manifest for autonomous grid telemetry, substation health scoring, and crisis triage.
- [Well-Known AI Catalog](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Standard discovery descriptor for autonomous AI agents and crawler registries.

## Disaster Resilience & Statutory SOPs
- [TNSDMA Statutory Disaster SOPs](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/): Statutory SLAs and emergency power shutoff procedures based on flood inundation thresholds.
- [GCC Ward Disaster Directory](https://surgegrid.nammamap.in/): Civic disaster committees, 200 Greater Chennai Corporation wards, relief shelters, and rapid response personnel.
